business_definition: Provider master record containing enrollment and demographic information
National Provider Identifier - unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to healthcare providers
State Medicaid provider identification number - 9-character alphanumeric identifier
Provider classification code - 2-character alphanumeric (X(02))
Condition: provider is an individual practitioner (VALUE 'IN')
Condition: provider is a group practice (VALUE 'GR')
Condition: provider is a healthcare facility (VALUE 'FA')
Healthcare provider taxonomy code - 10-character alphanumeric classification code
Risk assessment tier classification - 1-character alphanumeric (X(01))
Condition: provider assigned limited risk tier (VALUE 'L')
Condition: provider assigned moderate risk tier (VALUE 'M')
Condition: provider assigned high risk tier (VALUE 'H')
Provider enrollment status code - 1-character alphanumeric (X(01))
Condition: provider enrollment status is pending (VALUE 'P')
Condition: provider enrollment status is active (VALUE 'A')
Condition: provider enrollment status is terminated (VALUE 'T')
Condition: provider enrollment status is denied (VALUE 'D')
Provider screening result flag - 1-character alphanumeric (X(01))
Condition: provider has not been screened (VALUE 'U')
Condition: provider passed screening (VALUE 'P')
Condition: provider failed screening (VALUE 'F')
Provider enrollment effective date - 8-digit numeric date (YYYYMMDD format)
Provider re-evaluation due date - 8-digit numeric date (YYYYMMDD format)
Variant data field containing provider-specific information - 80-character alphanumeric (REDEFINES PRV-VARIANT)
Individual provider demographic data group (REDEFINES PRV-VARIANT)
Individual provider last name - 30-character alphanumeric
Individual provider first name - 20-character alphanumeric
Individual provider license number - 15-character alphanumeric
Individual provider license issuing state code - 2-character alphanumeric
Reserved placeholder field used for data structure alignment, padding, or holding constant values
Organization provider data group (REDEFINES PRV-VARIANT)
Organization legal business name - 40-character alphanumeric
Organization doing business as name - 30-character alphanumeric
Organization owner National Provider Identifier - 10-character alphanumeric
